title: Kiritanpo Spyglass
description: Turning a Spyglass into a Kiritanpo
body:
Turn your spyglass into a Kiritanpo
Your spyglass will turn into a Kiritanpo.
And of course, the appearance when you look through it will also change.
When I looked into Kiritanpo ![When I looked into Kiritanpo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/MBQWgcya/images/cffdb35115305ad660f6525650c55adb5f91f54b.png)
Recommended for those who like Kiritanpo
Made using Mcreator
By the way, visibility will decrease (lol)

日本語:
望遠鏡をきりたんぽに変えよう
あなたの望遠鏡がきりたんぽに変わります
覗いたときの見た目も変わったりします
きりたんぽを覗いたとき ![きりたんぽを覗いたとき](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/MBQWgcya/images/cffdb35115305ad660f6525650c55adb5f91f54b.png)
きりたんぽが好きな人におすすめです
Mcreatorを使って作りました
ちなみに視認性は下がります(笑)
